This '''national electoral calendar for 2025''' lists the national/[[Federation|federal]] elections held in 2025 in all [[List of sovereign states|sovereign states]] and their [[Dependent territory|dependent territories]]. [[By-election]]s are excluded, though national [[referendum]]s are included.{{Elections}}

** [[Elections in the Comoros|Comoros]], [[2025 Comorian parliamentary election|Parliament]]<ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-10-16 |title=Comoros Sets Parliamentary Elections for January 2025 |url=https://www.africa.com/comoros-sets-parliamentary-elections-for-january-2025/ |access-date=2024-12-01 |website=Africa.com}}</ref>
